purpose: Reviewed production inputs and acceptance targets, not a VARCO MCP tool payload or generated asset manifest.

generation_policy.tool_schema: Discover real node types and parameter schemas after OAuth; do not invent API fields from this document.
generation_policy.single_image_input: One subject, one full-body view. Use the single_view prompt. Turnarounds are consistency review inputs and must not be submitted as a multi-character image-to-3D source.

coordinate_contract.conversion_rule: Keep exactly one +Z asset to -Z actor correction in the wrapper; do not also rotate the mesh or rig by 180 degrees.
coordinate_contract.origin: ground projection between the feet at y=0 for characters; tile/module bottom reference for environment
coordinate_contract.root_transform: unit scale and no baked locomotion translation; bind pose and every animation share the same rest skeleton

quality_status: No generated candidate or final rig, material, animation, visual-quality, or hardware-performance result is implied by this specification.

material_contract.base_color: sRGB without directional lighting or painted contact shadows
material_contract.orm: linear packed R=occlusion G=roughness B=metallic; validate glTF slot wiring
material_contract.hair: scalp plus restrained alpha-scissor cards; preserve silhouette on web and inspect overdraw
material_contract.metallicity: metal for iron/gold, dielectric for skin/cloth/leather; wear changes roughness and exposed metal, not arbitrary glow

rig_contract.rest_pose: Humanoid-compatible T-pose for mapping; A-pose reference is generation input and must be corrected in Blender
rig_contract.bone_map: pending: map actual imported skeleton to SkeletonProfileHumanoid; do not infer compatibility from names alone
rig_contract.cloth_and_hair: first pass skinned to stable support bones; dynamic cloth is deferred
